C0405.title: Credentials Still the 'Achilles' Heel'? Cisco's Latest Report Reveals New Threats from Old Attack Patterns
C0405.summary: The 2025 Cisco Cybersecurity Readiness Index reports that identity-based attacks accounted for 60% of Cisco Talos incident response cases. Attackers use stolen or abused valid accounts to support initial access, lateral movement, and privilege escalation, exposing identity-security risks from credential reuse, phishing, and abused cloud access tokens.
